referenceSources.title: PEUGEOT CELEBRATES 125 YEARS OF MOTORSPORT SUCCESS  | Peugeot | Stellantis Media
referenceSources.description:
A silver Peugeot 206 WRC tears through a dusty gravel rally stage, its front wheels momentarily lifted as it powers through a sharp turn. Bold Total and Michelin branding adorn the hood and bumper, while the EURODATACAR decal runs along the lower front fascia. The car’s aerodynamic scoops and rally-spec wheels underscore its high-performance design.

The rugged dirt track winds past rocky outcrops and sparse vegetation, emphasizing the demanding off-road conditions. A plume of dust trails behind the car, capturing the speed and intensity of professional rally competition.
